indication_area: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (erosive esophagitis, non-erosive reflux); H. pylori
formulation: oral tablet (VOQUEZNA, VOQUEZNA DUAL PAK and VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK)

approval_evidence.quote: VOQUEZNA (vonoprazan) tablets, for oral use | Initial U.S. Approval: 2022 (FDA label of NDA 215151, revised 11/2023). The VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK and VOQUEZNA DUAL PAK label (NDA 215152 and 215153, https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2022/215152Orig1s000,215153Orig1s000lbl.pdf, revised 5/2022) also reads 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2022'.

launch_evidence.quote: To date, our only source of revenue has been from the U.S. sales of VOQUEZNA products, which the Company began selling during the fourth quarter of 2023.

series_start_reason: Phathom first prints product revenue in the Q4 2023 release (682 thousand, the only revenue in 2023); the series starts at that first sales quarter. Earlier quarters carry no revenue line.
notes: Scope: the company's only revenue line is 'Product revenue, net', and the 2026 Q2 10-Q states the company's only revenue source is U.S. sales of VOQUEZNA products (VOQUEZNA, VOQUEZNA DUAL PAK and VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK). The Dual and Triple Paks are formulations of the brand sold in the same line; no separate line is printed. Full-year checks: 2024 quarters sum to 55,252 (printed FY2024 55,252); 2025 quarters sum to 175,110 (printed FY2025 175,110). Phathom also issued 2026 revenue guidance of $310-325 million to $320-345 million in the Q2 2026 release; guidance is not used. Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 are read from their own releases. Approval year: the brand's first FDA approval is the VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK and VOQUEZNA DUAL PAK co-packs (NDA 215152 and 215153, label revised 5/2022, 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2022'); the FDA label for the stand-alone VOQUEZNA tablets (NDA 215151) carries the same 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2022', although that NDA was approved November 1, 2023 (Q4 2023 release: 'The FDA approved VOQUEZNA 10 mg and 20 mg tablets on November 1, 2023'). first_approval_year therefore follows the FDA's own 'Initial U.S. Approval' year, 2022, and not the tablet NDA's 2023 action date. The series' first quarter (2023Q4) is the tablet launch in November 2023.
